articles.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
articles.snippet: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

articles.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
articles.snippet: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.

articles.title: Musk’s X hit by wave of unsolicited password reset emails
articles.snippet: Multiple crypto industry figures and CoinDesk staff received unexpected password reset emails on Tuesday, though there is no evidence yet that X itself has been breached.

articles.title: Bitcoin enters ‘Rektember’ as rate-hike risk combines with seasonality to threaten rally
articles.snippet: September has historically been a poor month for risk assets in general, and bitcoin, in particular.

articles.title: Ethena pushes stablecoins into everyday banking with high-yield savings, cards and payments
articles.snippet: Ethena Pay offers a 6% dollar savings rate and 5% card cashback, using Avalanche for settlement.
